ai_content.description:
Shadow Dawg Firearms Academy - 5283 S Missoula Way, Boise, ID 83709

You'll find top-notch firearms training and instruction at Shadow Dawg Firearms Academy, just a stone's throw from the Boise Foothills. Folks here are passionate about Idaho's outdoor lifestyle, and they're dedicated to helping you get equipped for it safely. Their Idaho concealed carry classes (CCW) are perfect for anyone looking to get an Idaho permit - and trust me, once you've got that permit, you'll want to explore our beautiful state's mountains and rivers with confidence.

The academy offers a range of services, from firearms training to ammunition sales. They've also got tactical gear and accessories if you're looking to upgrade your rig for hunting or self-defense. If you live in the Boise area, it's worth checking out their schedule - they offer classes on everything from basic pistol safety to advanced rifle training. With experienced instructors and a relaxed atmosphere, Shadow Dawg Firearms Academy is the perfect place to learn about firearms and get ready for Idaho's great outdoors.
